title: Copilot Studio: agent responses in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat match Copilot Chat's own
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned response changes from existing agent controls and billing rules. The blocking path and Graph operation are documented, and searches found no setting or rollout instructions specific to this change.

claims.quote: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience.

claims.claim: For Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders, classic answers, generative answers and Microsoft Graph tenant grounding in agents used in Copilot Chat, Teams or SharePoint are not charged when the agent uses that user's authenticated identity.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center block path is Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select Block or Unblock. ... select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its use.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking is a general whole-agent availability control across the organisation rather than a switch for the new presentation.
claims.quote: Block and unblock | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Blocking a Copilot Studio agent affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot and other hosts such as Outlook and Teams.
claims.quote: Blocking or unblocking an agent that you created by using Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder and Microsoft Copilot Studio affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot. It also affects availability and functionality in other host products, such as Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams

claims.claim: The Graph block operation is a beta API and is subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API used for the block call requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The Graph block operation's delegated work-or-school permission is CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All | Not available.

claims.claim: The agent list is reached under Agents > All agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center. ... Select Agents > All agents. ... In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
